scope: Initialization candidate catalog; not an integration manifest or SOTA ranking.

status_definitions.source_verified: Official source identity and stated scope were checked. This does not verify implementation behavior or reported performance.
status_definitions.not_integrated: No official adapter / backend / scorer has been integrated in CADloop.
status_definitions.not_started: No local reproduction or benchmark measurement has been performed.

revision_policy: reviewed_* fields record source metadata observed during initialization; reproduction_* fields remain null until a concrete reproduction protocol is fixed.

entries.name: CADGenBench
outputs: one output.step or output.stp per fixture
entries.data_license: ODC-BY (public inputs, per official dataset card)
limitations: Reviewed dataset card declares 81 fixtures: 49 generation and 32 editing, with no train/test split; recheck counts at integration.
Ground truth is private according to the official README and dataset card. The unauthenticated ground-truth API returned HTTP 401; no ground truth was accessed.
Official leaderboard scoring requires external submission. Local public-input validity checks do not produce an official CAD Score.
Generation and editing use different score compositions; follow the fixed scorer revision rather than applying one formula to both.
Python 3.12+ is declared upstream; baseline rendering requires its native dependencies. No installation was attempted.

entries.name: CADBench: A Multimodal Benchmark for AI-Assisted CAD Program Generation
outputs: CadQuery Python program in per-sample JSONL
entries.data_license: Mixed constituent licenses; see official DATASET_LICENSE.md
metrics_to_verify: official run_eval_pipeline.py outputs; exact metric definitions and aggregation require code review
limitations: The name CADBench is ambiguous. This entry is explicitly the anniedoris / DeCoDELab paper benchmark, not other same-name repositories.

The reviewed README uses bench0 / bench0F / bench1-style subset names, while the reviewed Hugging Face metadata exposes benchB / benchF / benchE / benchA / benchM / benchO. Resolve and pin the official mapping before writing an adapter.
Data is derived from DeepCAD, Fusion 360 Gallery, ABC, MCB and Objaverse; constituent licenses and possible overlap must be tracked.
The README currently accepts CadQuery Python in generated fields and requires the final solid variable name for evaluation.
No dataset files, metric computation or leaderboard submission were run.

entries.name: SGP-Bench (CAD partitions)
inputs: symbolic CAD program and question; tool-rendered views only when allowed by the protocol
metrics_to_verify: official answer grading and CAD partition aggregation; verify before integration
limitations: This measures CAD program understanding and question answering, not CAD generation quality or STEP geometry reconstruction.
Official SGP-Bench evaluation and CAD-Assistant tool-augmented evaluation must be reported as separate protocols.
CAD-Assistant supplies preprocessed 700 2D and 1000 3D FreeCAD samples; verify correspondence to official SGP-Bench splits before comparison.
Code license is declared MIT in the reviewed README; dataset licensing and dataset revision have not yet been checked.

entries.name: DeepCAD data and evaluation protocol
inputs: Onshape-derived CAD construction sequences in JSON / vectorized H5
outputs: CAD construction sequence; STEP can be exported
limitations: DeepCAD names both a learned generative model and its released CAD sequence dataset; neither is an agent harness.
The original README evaluates autoencoding and random generation. Point-cloud-to-CAD or text-to-CAD tests on derived data use other methods and protocols.
Dataset revision, train/test file checksums, duplication policy and data license must be verified before download or comparison.
The reviewed environment targets Linux, Python 3.7, PyTorch 1.5+ and pythonocc-core 7.5.1; reproduce in an isolated upstream environment.
Derived DeepCAD subsets may overlap with CADBench and Text2CAD; their scores are not independent evidence without an overlap analysis.

entries.name: Text2CAD annotations and evaluation data
inputs: beginner-to-expert text annotations paired with DeepCAD-derived geometry
outputs: sequential CAD representation; evaluate with upstream Evaluation/eval_seq.py
metrics_to_verify: upstream sequential CAD evaluation; exact metrics and split version require review
limitations: Text2CAD includes a learned generation model as well as text annotations and data preparation code. It is not an agent harness.
The dataset exposes v1.0 and v1.1 assets. The chosen version, split and checkpoint must be fixed explicitly before experiments.
The reviewed Hugging Face metadata declares automatic gating and CC BY-NC-SA 4.0. Access may require accepting the dataset terms; no gated files were downloaded.
Derived from DeepCAD; preserve the official deduplication / split protocol and analyze overlap with other benchmarks.
The reviewed README targets Linux with Python 3.9+ and a conda environment; no environment or checkpoint was installed.
